# What does one braider's chair really earn, and should you braid, employ or rent it out?

> Free braiding studio calculator: enter knotless, cornrow and twist prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per style and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even styles per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a braider. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
